svg.title: Aryan Teng: full-stack product engineer, ex-founding engineer
svg.desc: I build products from zero to production, from Figma to the customer site. Built and shipped at Awiros: the UVIP platform rebuild, CV app delivery, Developer Mode, Seek vector search, enterprise SSO, the Delhi IGI airport operations suite, two mobile apps and a ClickHouse event pipeline. Previously founding engineer at Enveave.
